title: The Last 5 Years: Contemporary Pop Score Works Dramatically

contact_edits.before: The best musical in Toronto since who-knows-when: a through-sung two-hander about two young New Yorkers who meet, marry and bleakly part. His story, told chronologically, alternates with hers, told in reverse; they meet at the midpoint, their wedding -- an apt metaphor for the relationship of two people for whom love isn't enough. Jason Robert Brown's lyrics are very funny; his music is the first contemporary pop score to work dramatically. (Berkeley Street Theatre, 26 Berkeley St., 416-368-3110. Runs until May 29.)
